title: Matti Ko Bhi Shifa
body:
matti ko bhi shifa ka wasila bana diya
sarwar ne karbala ko masiha bana diya
<<DIVIDER>>
sar ta qadm kuch aise sawara hussain ne
akbar ko mustafa ka sarapa bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
aakar uroos e taygh ne qasim ke haath mein
maidan e kaarzaar ko dulha bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ne hunar se tadabbur se sabr se
darya ko pyaas pyaas ko darya bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
shahid hamein khuda ne aza e hussain par
insaniyat ki aankh ka taara bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
<<DIVIDER>>
bibi ko har qadam pe hai izzat ka apni taab
chaadar nahi to baalo se parda bana diya
matti ko bhi shifa...
author: Shahid Jafer
